_comment: Mock interview tracks. `domains`: five per career domain (career_catalog.json ids). `degree_tracks`: extra tracks offered when the student's education names one of the degrees (degrees.json codes). Each track's focus is given to the interviewer. The generic HR / Technical / Project types stay for the frozen evaluation.

cs.name: System Design
cs.focus: designing scalable services: requirements, APIs, data stores, caching, queues, trade-offs and failure handling

cs.name: Algorithm Walkthrough
cs.focus: solving a data-structures or algorithms problem aloud: approach, complexity, edge cases and testing

cs.name: Frameworks
cs.focus: the frameworks and tools on the resume: how they work inside, when not to use them, debugging them

cs.name: Behavioral STAR
cs.focus: teamwork, conflict, ownership and failure, answered with situation, task, action and a measurable result

cs.name: Project Defense
cs.focus: defending the candidate's own project: architecture, choices made, what broke, how it was tested and measured

ece.name: VLSI
ece.focus: digital design, Verilog, timing analysis, CMOS and the ASIC or FPGA flow

ece.name: Embedded Systems
ece.focus: microcontrollers, embedded C, interrupts, RTOS tasks, memory and peripheral protocols

ece.name: Signal Processing
ece.focus: sampling, transforms, filter design and real-time DSP trade-offs

ece.name: Circuit Debugging
ece.focus: finding faults in analog and digital circuits with instruments: a methodical debugging story

ece.name: Techno-HR
ece.focus: motivation for core electronics, teamwork in labs and projects, and how the candidate learns new hardware

mech.name: Thermal & Fluids
mech.focus: thermodynamic cycles, heat transfer, fluid flow and their use in real equipment

mech.name: CAD & GD&T
mech.focus: 3D modelling practice, drawings, tolerances, datums and design intent

mech.name: Manufacturing & Six Sigma
mech.focus: processes, process planning, quality tools, lean and DMAIC improvement

mech.name: EV Systems
mech.focus: electric powertrains, batteries and thermal management, vehicle dynamics

mech.name: Industrial Case Study
mech.focus: a shop-floor or design problem to analyse aloud: root cause, options, cost and safety

civil.name: Highway & Transport

civil.name: Site Safety
civil.focus: hazards on site, safety plans, permits, incident handling and codes of practice

eee.name: Power Systems

biotech.name: Bioprocess

biotech.name: Lab Case Study
